atoms.text: I am a receptionist. I help patients check in, tell them when they can see the doctor and schedule their next visit.
atoms.sound: I am a receptionist. I help patients check in, tell them when they can see the doctor, and schedule their next visit.

atoms.text: I am a nurse. I help doctors and care for patients by asking questions and taking vital signs.
atoms.sound: I am a nurse. I help doctors and care for patients by asking questions and taking vital signs.

atoms.text: I am a doctor. I treat patients and prescribe medicine. You tell me how you feel, and I help you get better.
atoms.sound: I am a doctor. I treat patients and prescribe medicine. You tell me how you feel, and I help you get better.

atoms.a: It looks like you have a rash. I will prescribe you some medicine and we can check back in a couple of weeks.
Let’s take your vital signs before the doctor comes to examine you.
Let’s schedule you another appointment. What day works best for you?
They examine patients and tell them what kind of treatment they need.
They prescribe patients the medicine they need to take.
They support doctors and help them with looking after patients.
They take the vital signs of patients and ask questions before the doctor comes to examine them.
They greet patients when they arrive.
Welcome! Please sign your name here and have a seat in the waiting room. The nurse will be with you shortly.
atoms.b: Welcome! Please sign your name here and have a seat in the waiting room. The ((nurse)) will be with you shortly.

atoms.a: Hi Dhruv, I’m Nurse Ahmed. First, I’m going to ask you some questions and then the doctor will come in to see you. What kind of symptoms are you experiencing?
atoms.b: Hi Dhruv, I’m Nurse Ahmed. First, I’m going to ask you some questions and then the ((doctor)) will come in to see you. What kind of symptoms are you experiencing?

atoms.a: I’m feeling quite ill, especially when I’m trying to sleep at night. I have a cough that isn’t getting any better.
atoms.b: I’m feeling quite ill, especially when I’m trying to sleep at night. I have a ((cough)) that isn’t getting any better.

atoms.a: I see. Well, let’s listen to your breathing, and then Dr Adams will come in to examine you. Are you also experiencing a sore throat at all?
atoms.b: I see. Well, let’s listen to your breathing, and then Dr Adams will come in to examine you. Are you also experiencing a ((sore_throat)) at all?

atoms.a: No, no sore throat, but I do have some neck pain when I wake up in the morning.
atoms.b: No, no sore throat, but I do have some ((neck_pain)) when I wake up in the morning.

atoms.a: Okay, I’ll write that down. Dr Adams will be with you in a moment and we’ll have you feeling better in no time!
atoms.b: Okay, I’ll write that down. Dr Adams will be with you in a moment and we’ll have you ((feeling)) better in no time!

atoms.a: Hi Dhroov! I hear you’re having trouble getting rid of a pesky cough. I’m going to prescribe you some antibiotics and then you can make an appointment with the receptionist so we can check in again in a couple of weeks.
atoms.b: Hi Dhruv! I hear you’re having trouble getting rid of a pesky cough. I’m going to prescribe you some antibiotics and then you can make an appointment with the ((receptionist)) so we can check in again in a couple of weeks.
